description: Recorded dogfood defect, cut from real merged history unmodified: the commit adds a 305-line verify_sync module whose stated purpose is that the compose pipeline proves the shipped mp4's sync, but nothing in the compose path invokes it — the only production-file change is a docstring documenting a MANUAL command, and the only code references are tests. The goal (a desynced artifact cannot ship silently) therefore does not occur through the caller production ships. A later commit wired it with a one-line import into compose.py, which is the record that the wiring was the missing piece.
